[SWS_DM_01055] Reaction on ApplicationError
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
If an external processor to read the
DID
data raises an error of
ara::diag::Di-
agUdsNrcErrorDomain
, the DM shall skip the scheduled periodic response for the
periodic DataIdentifier.
